environment.description: NestJS microservice deployed via Kubernetes pod spec with securityContext dropping CAP_NET_RAW and CAP_SYS_ADMIN from the capability bounding set. Pod uses a custom seccomp profile (runtime/default variant with additional restrictions) loaded via annotations. The container's root filesystem is mounted read-only (readOnlyRootFilesystem: true), with an emptyDir volume mounted at /tmp that has a 10Mi sizeLimit. The pod runs with runAsNonRoot: true (uid 1000) and allowPrivilegeEscalation: false. An AppArmor profile (runtime/default) is applied via annotation that restricts symlink creation to paths matching /app/uploads/** only.

config.custom_apparmor_rules: deny link /tmp/** -> /etc/**, deny symlink target=/etc/**, deny symlink target=/proc/**, owner /app/uploads/** rwl, owner /tmp/processing/** rw
